# Feature: Tauri Workspace Create Gate

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-10 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Local desktop project create fails because the workspace picker UI was never mounted. Wire `LocalWorkspaceProvider`, `FirstRunWorkspaceGate`, and Settings → Speicher workspace panel so users can pick a workspace and create `.scriptony` projects. Surface the real create error in the toast.

Roadmap: Desktop-first / T44–T59 follow-up (Stufe A) — wire existing workspace modules.

## Preconditions

- Tauri desktop shell, runtime profile `local` (`VITE_SCRIPTONY_RUNTIME=local`)
- No trusted workspace root stored yet (`get_stored_workspace_root` → null), or user opens Einstellungen → Speicher → Lokal
- User can authenticate / has local session as today

## Happy Path

- [ ] On first local-desktop launch without workspace root, `FirstRunWorkspaceGate` is shown (Ordner wählen…) instead of Projects
- [ ] After picking a folder, the main app (Navigation + Projekte) is reachable
- [ ] Einstellungen → Speicher → Anbieter „Lokal“ expanded shows Workspace-Ordner panel with path / wählen / wechseln
- [ ] Creating a project with title + genre succeeds under the chosen workspace (`.scriptony` folder)
- [ ] If create fails, toast shows the real `error.message` (e.g. missing workspace), not only the generic text

## Edge Cases

- [ ] G-02: Without workspace, create is blocked by gate (or clear workspace error) — features that need a workspace do not silently fail
- [ ] Cloud / browser profile: no FirstRunWorkspaceGate; existing cloud create path unchanged
- [ ] User cancels folder picker: gate stays; no crash
- [ ] `createLocalProject` re-applies `restoreWorkspaceScope()` before mkdir when root exists

## Regression

- [ ] Navigation Projekte / Einstellungen still load
- [ ] Existing `projectsApiAdapter` local create/list/delete tests pass
- [ ] Cloud-freeze: no new Appwrite imports

## Assumptions

- Auth gate remains as today; workspace gate runs after auth loading on local desktop when root is missing
- Components `FirstRunWorkspaceGate`, `LocalWorkspaceProvider`, `LocalStorageProviderPanel` already exist and only need wiring

## Implementation Notes

- Files touched: `src/App.tsx` (mount `LocalWorkspaceProvider`), `src/components/AppContent.tsx` (`FirstRunWorkspaceGate` on local desktop without root), `src/components/settings/StorageSettingsSection.tsx` (`LocalStorageProviderPanel` under Lokal), `src/lib/api-adapter/projects-local.ts` (`restoreWorkspaceScope` on create), `src/components/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx` (toast shows `error.message`)
- Unit tests: `projects-adapter.test.ts` — reject create without workspace; assert `restoreWorkspaceScope` on successful create
- Known limitations: Live Tauri UI verify still recommended (`@verify-ui` / manual Ordner wählen); gate runs after auth loading and before AuthPage when root missing
